title: Kissed Greek Pepper Avgolemono
description: Charred, molten, lazy-sunday Greek dish featuring roasted pepper, ssam-wrap, low-calorie-friendly, form=avgolemono. Serve warm with a sprinkle of sumac and crusty bread on the side.

ingredients.name: 2 red bell peppers
ingredients.notes: any color bell peppers work well, but red adds sweetness

instructions: Arrange bell peppers on a baking sheet, leaving space between each pepper.
Drizzle with 1 tablespoon olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and oregano. Roast for 30-40 minutes or until charred and tender, flipping halfway through.
While peppers are roasting, whisk together lemon juice, broth, garlic, and remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in a small bowl.
Once peppers are done, remove from oven and let cool slightly.
Peel off skin, seed, and chop peppers into small pieces.
In a large bowl, whisk together egg mixture, chopped peppers, and salt.
Heat a large non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Add a tablespoon of water to the skillet and swirl to coat.
Pour in egg mixture and cook until the bottom is set, about 2-3 minutes.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the eggs towards the center, tilting the skillet to allow uncooked egg to flow to the edges.
Continue cooking and folding until eggs are almost set, about 2-3 minutes more.
Warm ssam wraps according to package instructions.
To assemble, place a warmed ssam wrap on a plate, spoon a portion of the egg mixture onto the center of the wrap, and fold the bottom half up over the filling.
Repeat with remaining wraps and egg mixture.
Serve warm with a sprinkle of sumac and crusty bread on the side.
